definitions.gloss: groundbreaking ceremony (marking the start of a construction project)
definitions.explanation: A formal ceremony held at the start of a major construction project — typically a building, bridge, railway line, or other large piece of infrastructure. It usually involves dignitaries, developers, and contractors and may include a shovel-turning gesture or a Shinto purification rite.

examples.japanese: {起工式|きこうしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起工式|きこうしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: I attended the groundbreaking ceremony for the new station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}して→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧{市民病院|しみんびょういん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起工式|きこうしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The mayor attended the groundbreaking ceremony for the city hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{延伸工事|えんしんこうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起工式|きこうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{関係者|かんけいしゃ}→関係者：16441_kankeisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{鍬入|くわい}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: At the groundbreaking ceremony for the Shinkansen extension, officials performed the ritual turning of the earth.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{起工|きこう}→起工：24392_kikou⟧ ('commencement of construction') + {式|しき} ('ceremony'). The term refers to the public event, not the physical start of work.

USAGE:
- Used for large civil engineering and building projects — highways, railways, hospitals, schools, government buildings, stadiums, and corporate headquarters.
- Smaller residential projects more often use ⟦{地鎮祭|じちんさい}→地鎮祭：30680_jichinsai⟧ ('ground-purification ritual'), a Shinto rite focused on appeasing local spirits before construction.
- The verb paired with it is ⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ ('to hold, conduct'): {起工式|きこうしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ ('to hold a groundbreaking ceremony').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {起工式|きこうしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to hold a groundbreaking ceremony
- {起工式|きこうしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出席|しゅっせき}する→出席する：01830_shussekisuru⟧: to attend a groundbreaking ceremony
- {起工式|きこうしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧: (a ceremony) is held
- {起工式|きこうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{鍬入|くわい}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to perform the ritual earth-turning at the ceremony

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{地鎮祭|じちんさい}→地鎮祭：30680_jichinsai⟧: Shinto ground-purification ritual before construction
- {上棟式|じょうとうしき}: topping-out / framework-raising ceremony
- {竣工式|しゅんこうしき}: completion ceremony (marking the end of construction)
- ⟦{落成式|らくせいしき}→落成式：25608_rakuseishiki⟧: inauguration ceremony for a completed building

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Ceremonies are often held according to a lucky day on the traditional ⟦{六曜|ろくよう}→六曜：29161_rokuyou⟧ calendar (especially ⟦{大安|たいあん}→大安：16753_taian⟧). A Shinto priest may preside; participants wear formal attire and may wield a gold-painted ceremonial shovel or hoe.
